title: Paradise Villa
description: “Paradise Villa” is located in a residential area near Guro Digital Complex Station, where many office workers commute. From the semi-basement up to the 4th floor, where the landlord lives, the villa may look ordinary at first glance, but its tenants are anything but. Other than the fact that they live in the same building, they have nothing in common—different jobs, different relationships with those around them, and even different sexual preferences. From car-poor workers to sexless married couples, and even cohabiting partners… Their overflowing desires come to the surface.
